Mark 2026-09-05: seeds and prompts. Interpreted as both, on separate axes: X slerps x_T between seed A and seed B, Y lerps T5Gemma conditioning between prompt P and prompt Q. That is the four-corner bilinear model with corners constrained to {A,B} x {P,Q}. See D-014.

Mark 2026-09-05: render to disk, play back live. Every generation is persisted to an app-managed library as WAV plus a JSON lineage sidecar; playback is from in-memory buffers. Default library root ~/Music/SA3Local, user-changeable (root location is my assumption, flagged in D-015). Live performance output is also recordable to disk (lsa-aip). See D-015.
